files.description: Local HTTP service with health, version, notes and metrics endpoints backed by disposable SQLite data.
HTTP, readiness, persistence, backup and simulated release-restart assertions.
Local-only workload sampler, artifact checksum, SLO arithmetic and SQLite backup commands.
Checks operational arithmetic, checksums and redirect refusal for the local sampler.
Multi-stage container build that runs service tests and uses a non-root runtime.
Limits the container build context to the required app, tests and Dockerfile.
Setup, exact commands, expected results, cleanup and verification limits.
Opt-in CI example for review and adaptation; separate from the notebook publishing workflow.
Step-by-step learner integration of React, .NET and SQL with release and recovery evidence.
Three delivery projects with requirements, assessment rubrics and reference reasoning.
Runnable v1/v2/v1 source-artifact release, readiness gate, eligible-read SLI and rollback drill.
Distinct-artifact rollback and bounded startup failure checks.
Optional real mechanism drill with observable assertions and bounded cleanup.
Exact setup, expected results, cleanup, scope and primary references for the optional mechanism drill.
